settings.title: Benefits
settings.content:
• Firms and tones facial contours using the MyoLift Mini microcurrent device.
  • Brightens dull skin and helps even tone with vitamin C and prebiotic-rich formulas.
  • Enhances hydration and conductivity for more effective treatments.
  • Combines device and skincare essentials for an all-in-one facial system.
  • Suitable for consistent home use with professional-level results.

settings.title: What's Included?
settings.content:
• MyoLift Mini Device
  • 4 oz Mangosteen Facial Cleanser with Prebiotics
  • 1 oz ReVital C Serum [20% Vitamin C]
  • 3 Vitalizing Sheet Masks
  • 4 oz ReStore Conductive Gel
  • 2 oz RePlenish Spritzer
  • 1 Hands-Free Jowl Mask
  • 1 Hands-Free Lip Mask
  • 7E Silicone Brush
  • 7E MyoLift Headband
  • Splitter Wire

settings.title: How to use it?
settings.content:
1. Begin by cleansing your face with the Mangosteen Cleanser to remove impurities and prep the skin.
  2. Lightly mist your face with RePlenish Spritzer for hydration and improved conductivity.
  3. Apply ReStore Gel evenly across treatment areas.
  4. Connect your MyoLift Mini to either the probes or the included hands-free masks (Jowl and Lip) using the Splitter Wire.
  5. Run your preferred MyoLift Mini program (Erase or Educate) for lifting and toning.
  6. Remove masks, massage any remaining product into the skin, and finish with ReVital C Serum for brightening and nourishment.

settings.title: Who is this for?
settings.content:
• First-time MyoLift Mini users looking for a complete lifting and brightening setup.
  • Skincare enthusiasts seeking professional-grade microcurrent results at home.
  • Anyone who wants firmer, more radiant skin supported by clinically tested technology.

settings.heading: Frequently Asked Questions
settings.title1: What is the main benefit of this kit?
settings.text1: It firms, tones, and brightens the skin while enhancing microcurrent conductivity for professional-level results at home.
settings.text2: First-time MyoLift Mini users or anyone seeking an all-in-one lifting and brightening solution.
settings.title3: How do I use the hands-free masks?
settings.text3: Connect the Jowl or Lip mask to the Mini device using the splitter wire, apply gel to treatment areas, and run your preferred program.
settings.title4: How often should I perform treatments?
settings.text4: Use 2–3 times per week for best results. Daily use is optional for maintenance.
settings.title5: What skincare comes with the kit?
settings.text5: Mangosteen Cleanser, ReVital C Serum, ReStore Gel, RePlenish Spritzer, and masks designed to enhance lift, tone, and brightness.
settings.text6: Many users notice immediate tightening and radiance, with consistent improvements over 4–6 weeks.
